tips.text: Aim Noxious Blast slightly ahead of where the enemy is walking, because it explodes after a short delay. Hitting a champion also makes you faster for a moment.
Follow Noxious Blast with Twin Fang while the enemy is still poisoned. The poisoned hit does much more damage and heals you.
Use Twin Fang on minions only to finish them off. A kill refunds its mana, and the heal from minions is small.
Throw Miasma at an enemy's escape path. It slows them and stops dashes and other movement abilities.
Wait for the enemy to face you before casting Petrifying Gaze. Enemies facing away are only slowed, not stunned.
Use Twin Fang on a poisoned enemy you have stunned with Petrifying Gaze. They can't move, so it's a safe, high-damage follow-up.
Kite while you fight. Twin Fang doesn't interrupt your movement, so keep walking between casts and stay out of reach.

combos.name: Flash Petrifying Gaze
combos.when: When an enemy is just outside ultimate range, facing you, and a stun would let you or your team kill them.
combos.text: Flash toward the enemy and cast the gaze right away so they are still facing you and get stunned. Flash first so the cone lands from the new spot.

combos.name: Stun then fang spam
combos.when: After your gaze stuns an enemy who is already poisoned and you want maximum damage.
combos.text: A stunned target can't dodge or move, so the poisoned fang bonus keeps landing and heals you. Spam Twin Fang for the whole stun.

tips.text: Cast Noxious Blast ahead of where the enemy is walking, not on them; it explodes after a short delay. Hitting a champion also speeds you up.
Follow Noxious Blast with Twin Fang while the enemy is still poisoned; the bonus damage and healing only happen against poisoned targets.
Use Twin Fang on enemy minions to last-hit. A kill gives your Mana back.
Drop Miasma on enemies who try to dash in or run away. They are slowed and cannot use movement abilities while standing in it.
Aim Petrifying Gaze so enemies are looking at you. Those facing you are stunned; those turned away are only slowed.
Keep moving between spells. Twin Fang does not stop your movement, so you can kite while firing it.
Stay behind minions so Ahri's Charm hits them first and not you. Charm stops at the first enemy it hits.
Open with Noxious Blast and follow with Twin Fang on the poisoned Ahri. The extra damage and healing make trades favor you.
Cast Miasma on Ahri's path when she dashes in or out. She is slowed and grounded, so she can't use movement abilities.
Hold Petrifying Gaze until Ahri faces you, as when she walks in to cast. Facing you gets her stunned, and a stunned target is easy to hit with Twin Fang.
Lead Noxious Blast toward where Ahri is walking, because it lands after a short delay. Hitting a champion with it speeds you up, so use it to dodge Charm.
Be more aggressive when Ahri's Spirit Rush is on cooldown. She has little means to escape or dive you.

comboRefs.note: A stunned Ahri can't dodge, so the fangs keep landing; she must avoid facing you or the stun fails.

tips.text: Put Miasma on Akali when she dives in; she is grounded and slowed, so she cannot use her dashes to escape or close the gap.
Keep poisoning her with Noxious Blast, then hit her with Twin Fang for big damage and healing.
Face Akali and cast Petrifying Gaze when she jumps onto you; she is stunned if she faces you.
Throw Noxious Blast at the edge of her Twilight Shroud when she hides; area spells still hit her and reveal her.
Cast Miasma on Akshan when he swings in or out; he is grounded, so he can't use movement abilities, and he is slowed.
Land Noxious Blast on Akshan, then hit him with Twin Fang while he is poisoned for big damage and healing.
Aim Noxious Blast ahead of where he is walking; it explodes after a short delay, and his move speed bursts make it easy to miss.
Use Petrifying Gaze when Akshan is facing you, such as when he runs in to attack, so he is stunned.
Sidestep Flash Frost; it keeps flying after it hits. Dodge the detonation at the end too, since it stuns.
Hit Anivia with Noxious Blast when she is stationary or casting, then use Twin Fang on her while she is poisoned.
Do not stand in Glacial Storm; it slows you more as it grows. Step out of it early.
Use Petrifying Gaze when Anivia is facing you to stun her. Her egg will be vulnerable, so be ready to kill it.
Frostbite hits much harder on chilled targets, so avoid being hit by Flash Frost and then taking a quick follow-up.
Watch Annie's Pyromania counter. When her stun is ready, stay out of range of her Disintegrate and Incinerate.
Poke Annie with Noxious Blast, then hit her with Twin Fang while she is poisoned for extra damage and healing.
Put Miasma on Annie when she steps in to trade. It slows her and stops her dashing, so she cannot easily close the gap.
Use Petrifying Gaze when Annie or Tibbers charges at you. If she is facing you, she is stunned.
Stay away from Tibbers once Annie summons him. He burns everyone nearby, so keep your distance.
Poke with Noxious Blast when Aurelion Sol walks up to last-hit; it also gives you a burst of speed when it hits him.
Use Twin Fang on him whenever Noxious Blast or Miasma has poisoned him; the hit does much more damage and heals you.
Put Miasma on his landing spot when he flies in; he can't use movement abilities inside it and is slowed.
Step out of the center of Singularity quickly; it drags you in and can kill you if you are low on health.
Move sideways when Falling Star is aimed at you; it lands after a delay and stuns, so you can dodge it.
Cast Petrifying Gaze when he is facing you, such as after he breathes at you, for a stun. Follow with Twin Fang on the stunned target.
Aim Noxious Blast at where Aurora will step, not where she stands; it lands after a short delay and gives you a burst of speed if it hits.
Follow a poisoned Aurora with Twin Fang; it hits much harder on poisoned targets and heals you.
Drop Miasma where Aurora will land after Across the Veil or Between Worlds; she is grounded and slowed there and cannot use movement abilities.
Save Petrifying Gaze for when Aurora is facing you, such as when she dashes in; she is stunned only if she faces you.
Step out of the line of The Weirding; her slow makes you easy to hit with her follow-up.

comboRefs.note: A stun stops Aurora from dodging, so Twin Fang keeps landing while she is held in place.

tips.text: Aim Noxious Blast at where Azir will step, not where he stands. Hitting him gives you a burst of Move Speed to chase or step away.
Use Twin Fang on Azir once Noxious Blast has him poisoned. It hits much harder and heals you.
Drop Miasma where Azir wants to dash. He gets grounded and slowed, so Shifting Sands cannot be used to escape.
Cast Petrifying Gaze while Azir faces you, such as when he dashes in or walks up. He gets stunned, so follow with Twin Fang.
Stay out of his Sand Soldiers' stab range. Trade when his soldiers have expired or been used.
Dodge Brand's Sear. He needs to land a spell first, so missing it breaks his combo.
Keep Noxious Blast on him to poison him, then use Twin Fang for extra damage and healing while he stays in range.
Stay away from your minions when Brand is up; Conflagration spreads through them and onto you.
Use Petrifying Gaze when he walks toward you, so he faces you and is stunned. Then follow with Twin Fang on his poisoned body.
Walk out of Pillar of Flame as soon as it appears under you. It lands after a short delay.
Cast Miasma on the ground Briar will leap to; it grounds her, so she can't use movement abilities inside the clouds, and it slows her.
Poke with Noxious Blast while Briar walks up, then follow with Twin Fang for the bonus damage on a poisoned target.
Face Briar and use Petrifying Gaze when she charges in, so she is stunned. If she has her back turned, she is only slowed.
Keep your distance from Briar. Head Rush stuns her target, so stay out of its range and don't let her reach you.
Briar heals from her bleed and her attacks, so don't take long trades. Poison her and hit her with Twin Fang at range, then back off.

comboRefs.note: Briar's Blood Frenzy makes her face you, so Petrifying Gaze stuns her and fangs can all land.
Flash Petrifying Gaze can stun Briar if she is facing you, setting up a kill.

tips.text: Keep Miasma ready for when Diana dashes in with Lunar Rush; it leaves her grounded and slowed, so she can't use movement abilities to escape.
Face Diana when you cast Petrifying Gaze at level 6. She is stunned only if she is facing you, so use it as she walks toward you.
Poke with Noxious Blast and Twin Fang from range. Twin Fang hits much harder and heals you when Diana is poisoned.
Step out of the way of Crescent Strike. A hit reveals you and lets Diana dash to you and use Lunar Rush again right away.
Hold your damage while Pale Cascade's shield is up. Poke her after the orbs fade.
Cast Miasma on Phase Dive's landing spot; it grounds Ekko, so he loses the bonus range on his dash attack.
Land Noxious Blast, then follow with Twin Fang on the poisoned Ekko for strong damage and healing.
Step out of the Timewinder line, because it hits you again when it returns. Stay away from the field it leaves, which slows you.
Use Petrifying Gaze when Ekko dives at you, facing you. He is stunned and can't escape easily.
Walk out of the Parallel Convergence zone before it arms. If Ekko can't reach it, it only slows you.
Cast Miasma on Ezreal's side when he blinks; the clouds leave him grounded, so Arcane Shift cannot be used to escape them.
Lead your Noxious Blast toward where Ezreal is walking; he is fragile, and each hit on him gives you a burst of Move Speed.
Follow Noxious Blast with Twin Fang while he is poisoned; it hits much harder and heals you.
Stay out of a straight line with Ezreal and keep minions between you, so Mystic Shot hits a minion instead of you.
Use Petrifying Gaze when Ezreal is facing you; he is stunned, and Twin Fang on a stunned, poisoned target does full damage.
Keep Miasma ready for when Fizz jumps in; it grounds him, so he can't use movement abilities while he stands in the clouds.
Hit Fizz with Noxious Blast, then follow with Twin Fang. Poisoned targets take much more damage and you heal.
Keep your distance from Fizz and poke him with Twin Fang, because he has to dash in to fight you.
Save Petrifying Gaze until Fizz is facing you. He is stunned only if he looks at you, and slowed if he turns away.
Move away from the target spot when Fizz uses Chum the Waters on you. The shark knocks you up after a delay.

comboRefs.note: Fizz's Playful makes him untargetable, so land the stun first and then spam fangs on him.

tips.text: Stay out of Justice Punch range, and do not walk up to hit him; it knocks you up for her whole poison rotation to be wasted.
Poke with Noxious Blast, then follow with Twin Fang on the poisoned Galio for extra damage and healing.
Galio is slowed while charging Shield of Durand; hit him with Miasma then. His magic shield still absorbs some of your damage.
Do not stand close when Galio releases Shield of Durand; the taunt forces you toward him. Wait it out.
Face Galio when you cast Petrifying Gaze so it stuns him, then finish with Twin Fang.
Watch for Hero's Entrance across the map. Stay clear of the landing spot, and stun him while he is channeling.
Punish Hwei right after he casts a Torment spell; he is easy to rush down then. Step in with Noxious Blast and Twin Fang.
Hit Hwei with Noxious Blast, then follow with Twin Fang while he is poisoned for much bigger damage.
Keep moving unpredictably; Hwei needs to guess where you will be. Noxious Blast hitting him gives you extra speed to dodge his spells.
Do not stand still or alone in lane; his lightning hits much harder on an isolated target. Move around between casts.
Aim Petrifying Gaze at Hwei while he faces you to stun him, then finish with Twin Fang.

comboRefs.note: Hwei's Grim Visage makes enemies flee, so a stunned, poisoned Hwei can't dodge the fang spam.

tips.text: Keep Miasma ready for when Irelia dashes in. It grounds her so she can't use Bladesurge, and it slows her.
Face Irelia when you cast Petrifying Gaze. She is stunned if she is facing you, so use it as she dashes at you.
Clear the minions near you. Irelia needs them to dash with Bladesurge, and a lane with few minions leaves her with fewer ways to reach you.
Don't waste Petrifying Gaze on Defiant Dance. She takes less damage while charging, so wait for her to finish.
Poison Irelia with Noxious Blast and follow with Twin Fang for big damage and healing. Hit her as she walks up to last-hit.
Stay away from where Flawless Duet could catch you. If you are stunned, Irelia's follow-up comes quickly.

comboRefs.note: Petrifying Gaze stuns Irelia if she faces Cassiopeia, so Twin Fang keeps landing for the whole stun.

tips.text: Poison Kassadin with Noxious Blast as he walks up, then follow with Twin Fang for the big damage.
Place Miasma where Kassadin will land; it slows him and stops him using Riftwalk to escape.
Kassadin takes reduced magic damage, so kite him and keep your distance rather than trading all in.
Do not channel near him; Null Sphere interrupts channels and shields him.
Face Kassadin when he blinks in with Riftwalk and use Petrifying Gaze to stun him.
Put Miasma on the spot where Katarina wants to land. Grounded, she cannot use Shunpo, and she is slowed.
Hold Petrifying Gaze until Katarina dashes in facing you. Then she is stunned and cannot use Death Lotus.
Hit her with Noxious Blast when she walks up to Daggers. It poisons her, so Twin Fang then hits much harder.
Death Lotus is cast on the nearest champions and can be interrupted. Stun her mid-channel with Petrifying Gaze.
Poison LeBlanc with Noxious Blast, then follow with Twin Fang for extra damage and healing.
Put Miasma where LeBlanc will land. Her Distortion is blocked while grounded, so she cannot dash away.
Save Petrifying Gaze for when LeBlanc dashes at you and faces you. She will be stunned and cannot return with Distortion.
Sidestep Ethereal Chains and keep moving. Breaking the tether before it ends avoids the root.
Keep Noxious Blast and Twin Fang going from long range; Lissandra has to come close to use Ring of Frost.
Stay out of Ring of Frost range when it is ready. Once it is on cooldown, step in and trade.
Lissandra can't use Glacial Path to escape while she is grounded, so put Miasma on her when she tries to dash away or in.
Stand behind your minions so Ice Shard hits them first and you avoid the slow.
Dodge Ice Shard by sidestepping; the missile is narrow. Hitting her with Noxious Blast gives you speed to move away.
Face Lissandra when you cast Petrifying Gaze so she is stunned, but expect her to turn and dash away with Glacial Path.
Step sideways out of the line when Lux casts Light Binding. Being rooted stops you from trading back with Twin Fang and Noxious Blast.
Stand behind a minion so Light Binding hits it first; it only roots the first two enemies it touches.
Hit Lux with Noxious Blast, then follow with Twin Fang while she is poisoned for big damage and healing.
Use Noxious Blast on Lux for the Move Speed it gives, then walk out of the area of Lucent Singularity.
At level 6, face Lux and cast Petrifying Gaze when she is close. If she is facing you, she gets stunned and can't answer.
Respect Final Spark when low on health. Move to the side as soon as you see the red line.
Poke with Noxious Blast, then follow with Twin Fang while he is still poisoned for the bonus damage and healing.
Stay out of his Call of the Void line and sidestep it; being silenced stops you from casting Twin Fang.
Wait for his Void Shift to be used up before you commit to a trade; it cuts most damage and blocks your stun.
Drop Miasma on him when he tries to escape; it slows him and he cannot use movement abilities.
Use Petrifying Gaze only when he faces you, or he is merely slowed. Then finish with Twin Fang.
Stay away from minions carrying Malefic Visions; when they die it jumps to you.
Hold Petrifying Gaze until Mel has used Rebuttal or Solar Snare, then turn and cast it so she cannot run out of the cone.
Wait for Mel to cast Rebuttal before you throw Noxious Blast or Twin Fang. Rebuttal destroys enemy projectiles and shields her.
Mel's Solar Snare roots you longer the farther it travels, so stay out of its long range. Sidestep it or stay behind minions.
Lay Miasma where Mel stands or retreats. It grounds and slows her, so she cannot use movement abilities to escape.
Back off when you are low. Mel's Overwhelm stacks can execute you after a few hits, so stay away from her for a moment.
After Noxious Blast lands, follow with Twin Fang on the poisoned Mel for heavy damage and healing.
Keep Miasma on the ground where Naafiri will land. It leaves her grounded, so she can't use Eviscerate to dash in, and it slows her.
Aim Petrifying Gaze at Naafiri while she is running at you. She will be facing you, so she gets stunned instead of slowed.
Poke with Noxious Blast from long range. Hitting her also gives you bonus Move Speed to step back from her dash.
Follow Noxious Blast with Twin Fang on her while she is poisoned. It hits harder and heals you.
Don't spend Petrifying Gaze when she vanishes with The Call of the Pack. She can't be targeted at first, so wait until she reappears.
Hit Orianna with Noxious Blast, then follow with Twin Fang; poisoned targets take much more damage and you heal.
Stay out of Orianna's Ball range. Her Command: Shockwave can drag you in, so keep distance from the Ball when she is level 6 or above.
Use Miasma to stop Orianna running from you; it slows her and she cannot use movement abilities.
Orianna's Ball sits where she left it. Step away from it to dodge her pulse and avoid the pull.

comboRefs.note: Petrifying Gaze stuns Orianna, and Twin Fang then keeps hitting her for the whole stun.

tips.text: Keep Miasma on Qiyana when she dashes in; she is grounded and cannot use Audacity or Terrashape while she stands in the clouds.
Hold Petrifying Gaze for when Qiyana dives at you; she is stunned if she is facing you, so cast it as she closes in.
Poke with Noxious Blast and Twin Fang while Qiyana's abilities are on cooldown; a poisoned target takes much more from Twin Fang.
Stay out of the river and brush edges when you fight; Supreme Display of Talent stuns you wherever it wraps around the terrain.
Do not stand still near water when Qiyana holds the river element; Elemental Wrath can root you before she dives.

comboRefs.note: Stunned Qiyana can't dodge, so Twin Fang keeps landing on her while Petrifying Gaze holds her.

tips.text: Keep Noxious Blast landing on Ryze; the poison turns on Twin Fang's bonus damage and healing. Then follow up with Twin Fang.
Stay out of Rune Prison range when you can. If Ryze has marked you with Spell Flux first, you get rooted.
Be careful when Ryze has marked you with Spell Flux. His Overload then hits much harder.
Cast Petrifying Gaze when Ryze is facing you, ideally after he commits to a spell. He gets stunned.
Stun Ryze when he opens Realm Warp. A stun cancels the portal.
Keep Miasma ready for when Sylas dashes in; it leaves him grounded, so he can't use Abscond to escape or close the gap.
Stay out of Sylas's line when he has Abscond ready. If Abduct hits you, you are stunned and knocked up.
Poke with Noxious Blast and follow with Twin Fang on the poisoned Sylas. Both are cheap to repeat while he waits on cooldowns.
Hold Petrifying Gaze for when Sylas dashes at you. If he faces you, he is stunned.
Sylas heals with Kingslayer when he is low, so finish him fast with Twin Fang instead of letting him trade back.
Once you reach level 6, expect Sylas to steal Petrifying Gaze. Don't stand facing him when he is close and it is ready.
Stay out of Syndra's Scatter the Weak line when you can; if a Dark Sphere gets pushed into you, you are stunned and easy to burst.
Use Miasma where Syndra wants to step; it slows her and she cannot use dashes while she stands in it.
Hit Syndra with Noxious Blast, then follow with Twin Fang while she is poisoned for a big damage trade and some healing.
Aim Petrifying Gaze when Syndra is walking toward you, since only enemies facing you get stunned.
Move after casting Noxious Blast; the speed boost from hitting her helps you dodge Dark Sphere.

comboRefs.note: Flash gaze can catch Syndra just outside range if she faces you, stunning her for a kill.

tips.text: Stay out of Taliyah's Unraveled Earth stones when you can; if she knocks you into them with Seismic Shove, you get stunned.
Poke with Noxious Blast, then use the Move Speed it gives you to step out of her Threaded Volley rocks.
Follow Noxious Blast with Twin Fang while she is poisoned; it hits much harder and heals you.
Cast Miasma on her escape path; it stops her from dashing, and she is slowed inside it.
Cast Petrifying Gaze while she faces you, as when she walks in to trade. If she turns away she is only slowed.
Cast Petrifying Gaze when Talon dives at you; he is stunned if he faces you, and slowed if he has turned away.
Put Miasma where Talon will land. He is slowed and grounded, so he cannot use movement abilities to get away.
Poke him with Noxious Blast, then hit him with Twin Fang while he is poisoned. The heal and damage win the long trades.
Stay away from walls. Talon vaults over them with Assassin's Path to reach you.
Keep Noxious Blast ready for when he vanishes with Shadow Assault and comes back. Its speed boost helps you get away.
Aim Noxious Blast where Twisted Fate will walk, not where he stands. Hitting him gives you a burst of speed.
Use Twin Fang on him while he is poisoned; it hits much harder and heals you.
Stay back when he is shuffling cards; a Gold Card attack stuns you and he follows up with Wild Cards.
Drop Miasma on him if he tries to teleport with Destiny or to dash in. It stops him from using movement abilities.
When Twisted Fate uses Destiny, expect a gank or a teleport on you. Back off toward your team.
Cast Petrifying Gaze when he is facing you, such as when he walks up for a card attack, to stun him.

comboRefs.note: A gaze stun stops Twisted Fate from moving while the fangs keep hitting him.

tips.text: Don't fight inside Event Horizon's edge. Stay in the middle or outside so you can't be stunned.
Hit Veigar with Noxious Blast, then use Twin Fang on the poisoned target to trade hard and heal.
Keep moving while Veigar casts Dark Matter; it lands after a delay and can be walked out of.
Use Petrifying Gaze when Veigar faces you to stun him, and finish him since he is fragile.

comboRefs.note: Petrifying Gaze stuns a facing Veigar, so Twin Fang can land through the whole stun.

tips.text: Miasma grounds Vex, so she can't use movement abilities inside the clouds. Drop it on her when she tries to dash in with Shadow Surge.
Vex's Shadow Surge cannot be recast while she is grounded, so Miasma can stop her follow-up dash.
Stay out of Vex's Looming Darkness range when her Doom 'n Gloom is ready. Her empowered ability fears you and ruins your Twin Fang rhythm.
Poison Vex with Noxious Blast, then hit her with Twin Fang for the bonus damage and healing. Use it when she steps up to trade.
Use Petrifying Gaze only when Vex is facing you, or she is just slowed. Then finish her with Twin Fang while she is stunned.

comboRefs.note: Flash into Petrifying Gaze can stun a Vex who is just out of range and facing you.

tips.text: Hit Viktor with Noxious Blast, then follow with Twin Fang while he is poisoned for big damage and healing.
Stay out of Gravity Field. If you are caught, walk out quickly before the stun lands.
Sidestep Hextech Ray; it is a thin line, so move across it rather than away from him.
Use Miasma on Viktor when he steps forward to trade; the clouds slow him and keep him from using movement abilities.
At level 6, cast Petrifying Gaze only when Viktor faces you, so he is stunned. Then finish with Twin Fang.
Hit Vladimir with Noxious Blast when he walks up to last-hit. It also gives you speed to back away.
Aim Petrifying Gaze when Vladimir is facing you, since that stuns him. Don't cast it when he's walking away, since that only slows him.
Don't waste Miasma or Petrifying Gaze while Sanguine Pool is active. He can't be targeted in it, so wait until he comes out.
Stay out of Sanguine Pool's range when he sinks. It slows and hurts you while you stand in it.
Kill Vladimir before Hemoplague bursts, because it heals him for each champion hit.
Walk up and use Noxious Blast on Xerath when he is charging Arcanopulse; he is slowed and moves poorly, so it is easy to hit.
Hit Xerath with Noxious Blast, then follow with Twin Fang; poisoned targets take much more damage and you heal.
Use Miasma where Xerath will step to dodge. It slows him and he cannot use movement abilities while in it.
Stay out of a straight line with Xerath and keep moving sideways. Shocking Orb stops at the first enemy it hits, so stand behind a minion when you can.
Save Petrifying Gaze for when Xerath is stunned or walking toward you. He is stunned only if he faces you.
Step in close to Xerath and trade. His range is long, so you win by closing the gap.
Keep Noxious Blast going on Xin Zhao as he approaches. Aim ahead of him as he walks toward you.
Drop Miasma on your own feet or at his path when he charges in. It slows him and grounds him so he can't dash.
Back away when his Three Talon Strike is ready; the third hit knocks you up and sets up his whole fight.
Use Petrifying Gaze when he dashes at you. He is facing you, so he gets stunned.
Stay away from him when his Crescent Guard is ready; it knocks you back and stuns you at close range.
Use Twin Fang on a poisoned Xin Zhao for extra damage and healing while you keep your distance.
Keep Miasma away from Yasuo's Wind Wall: it blocks the portion of Miasma it hits. Wait for the wall to drop, then cast.
Bait Wind Wall with a Noxious Blast, then use Twin Fang, which a wall also blocks, once it fades.
Put Miasma down on Yasuo when he dashes in; it grounds him, and he can't use movement abilities like Sweeping Blade.
Use Petrifying Gaze when Yasuo is running at you; he gets stunned if he faces you, so you can follow up with Twin Fang.
Stay at long range and use Twin Fang on poisoned Yasuo; his whirlwind from Steel Tempest is a line, so sidestep it.
Poke with Noxious Blast when Yone walks up to last-hit; the speed boost it gives you on a champion hit helps you slip away.
Cast Miasma where Yone will dash in. He is grounded and slowed inside it, so he can't close the gap with a movement ability.
Use Twin Fang on Yone only while he is poisoned, since the extra damage and healing need the poison. It also reaches him at a safe distance.
Face Yone and cast Petrifying Gaze while he is running at you, so he is stunned. If he turns away he is only slowed.
Stay back from Yone once he has two stacks of Mortal Steel, because the third cast dashes in and knocks you up.

comboRefs.note: A stunned Yone can't dodge or move, so the poisoned fang spam keeps landing and heals you.

tips.text: Keep Miasma ready for when Zed uses Death Mark; it grounds him so he can't use movement abilities, and it slows him.
Drop Miasma on his shadow's landing spot or where he wants to swap, so he can't swap away while grounded.
Poke with Noxious Blast and then Twin Fang while he is poisoned; stay at range so his Shadow Slash can't reach you.
Face Zed when he dives in and cast Petrifying Gaze so he is stunned, then follow up with Twin Fang on the stunned, poisoned target.
Walk away from his Razor Shuriken sideways; Noxious Blast's speed boost helps you dodge once it hits him.
Stay out of line with Sleepy Trouble Bubble. If she hits you, you fall asleep and take extra damage from the next hit.
Punish Zoe after she uses Portal Jump. She can't move while there, so hit her with Noxious Blast.
Lay Miasma in her path when she tries to close in. It slows her and stops her from using movement abilities.
Use Twin Fang on her while Noxious Blast poisons her. It hurts more and heals you.
Zoe's Paddle Star hurts most from far away. Stay out of its line, or stand close to her so it deals less.
Hit Ashe with Noxious Blast to get a burst of Move Speed, then follow with Twin Fang while she is poisoned.
Stay out of Ashe's Volley lines and keep minions in front of you to absorb the arrows.
Cast Miasma on Ashe when she backs away; it leaves her slowed and unable to dash.
Use Petrifying Gaze when Ashe is facing you for a stun, then lay on damage. She has few ways to escape.
Stay in sight of your team when Enchanted Crystal Arrow is ready; a stun from far away gets you killed.
Stay out of Caitlyn's long range. Walk up only when you can land Noxious Blast, then leave before she answers.
Watch the ground before you step forward; Yordle Snap Trap roots you where you stand, and Caitlyn gets a bonus Headshot.
Hold Miasma for when Caitlyn fires her net to reposition. It slows her and stops her dashing.
Stay behind your minions when Caitlyn fires Piltover Peacemaker; it deals less damage to each target after the first.
Use Twin Fang on a poisoned Caitlyn for extra damage and healing, and use Petrifying Gaze when she faces you.
Cast Miasma on Ezreal's escape path; he is grounded inside it, so Arcane Shift cannot be used to blink away.
Aim Noxious Blast where Ezreal will walk, not where he stands; it lands after a short delay.
Follow every Noxious Blast that hits with Twin Fang; poisoned targets take much more damage and you heal.
Stay out of line with Ezreal and keep minions between you, so Mystic Shot hits a minion first.
Use Petrifying Gaze when Ezreal is facing you. He is stunned, and then you can finish with Twin Fang.
Use Miasma on Jhin when he steps up to attack; it grounds and slows him, so he can't dash away and has trouble dodging Noxious Blast.
Land Noxious Blast, then follow with Twin Fang. Poisoned targets take much more damage, and you heal from it.
Stay out of a straight line from Jhin. When he is hitting you, Deadly Flourish can root you, so don't stand still in his sight.
Hit Jhin with Petrifying Gaze while he faces you to stun him. Follow with Twin Fang for big damage on the stunned target.
Walk around bushes and chokepoints carefully; Jhin hides Captive Audience traps there. Walking into one slows you.
Trade while Jhin is reloading his fourth shot; he can't attack then, so you can poke him freely.
Keep Miasma on Jinx when she steps up to attack; it slows her and stops her using movement abilities.
Hit Jinx with Noxious Blast, then use Twin Fang on her while she is poisoned for big damage and healing.
Make Jinx face you before Petrifying Gaze, since she is only stunned when she faces you. Cast it when she walks toward you.
Walk out of the way of Flame Chompers and fight her after she has used them. Without them she has a hard time escaping.
Put Miasma on Kai'Sa when she wants to dive; while it grounds her she can't use the dash from Killer Instinct.
Cast Petrifying Gaze when Kai'Sa is walking toward you; she is stunned if she faces you and only slowed if she turns away.
Lead your Noxious Blast where Kai'Sa is walking. A hit speeds you up, so follow with Twin Fang while she is poisoned.
Use Twin Fang on poisoned Kai'Sa to trade damage and heal back what she poked off you.
Use Noxious Blast on Miss Fortune, leading her path; hitting a champion gives you speed.
Hit Miss Fortune with Noxious Blast, then Twin Fang her for strong damage while she is poisoned.
Damage Miss Fortune to cancel her speed boost from Strut; poke her whenever she walks up to last-hit.
Drop Miasma on her when she dashes in or tries to run; she cannot use movement abilities and is slowed.
Don't stand in front of Miss Fortune during Bullet Time; step out of the cone or use Petrifying Gaze while she faces you to stun her.
Wait for Spell Shield to be used before casting Petrifying Gaze. Sivir can block it and heal.
Fire Noxious Blast ahead of Sivir's path, then use Twin Fang on her while she is poisoned for big damage.
Drop Miasma where Sivir wants to walk. It slows her and stops her dashes.
Stay out of Boomerang Blade's line, and watch for it coming back after it reaches full range.
Land Noxious Blast on Smolder early, while he is weak and has few stacks. Follow with Twin Fang, which hits harder on a poisoned target.
Lead your Noxious Blast toward where Smolder is walking, because it explodes after a short delay.
Drop Miasma where Smolder will stand; it leaves him slowed and grounded, so he can't dash away.
Keep moving sideways to dodge his long-range Achooo!, which slows you if it hits.
Use Petrifying Gaze when Smolder is facing you, to stun him for a free kill. If he flees, it only slows him.
Aim Noxious Blast where Yunara is walking, not where she stands; it lands after a short delay.
Use Twin Fang on Yunara right after Noxious Blast hits. A poisoned target takes much more damage and heals you.
Throw Miasma on Yunara's escape path. She is slowed and grounded, so she can't use movement abilities.
Save Petrifying Gaze for when Yunara faces you. She is stunned then, and only slowed if she turns away.
Play safe when Yunara uses Transcend One's Self. Her dash and extra attack speed make her much harder to catch and kill.
